claims.text: Accept license agreements
Select components to install (Server and/or Web UI)
Provide a license file
Specify service account (user and password for services and database access)
System configuration check performed
Choose Microsoft SQL Server: existing or new instance (default LOCALHOST\VEEAMSQL2017), database name, SQL auth credentials
Review installation settings
Specify data location
Security certificate or thumbprint, otherwise new self-signed certificate generated
Ports: hub 9999, management 1989, Web UI 1280, ConnectWise plugin 9996 by default
Review installation summary including option to allow automatic product update checks
Before you begin: machine meets requirements, required ports open, distributed machines can communicate
A machine that meets software and hardware requirements
Server component machine must have internet access
Microsoft SQL Server hosting the database must be installed on a dedicated machine
Veeam Cloud Connect server must be installed on a dedicated machine
Veeam Cloud Connect license installed on that server
Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 REST API must be installed and activated for communication
Veeam ONE setup file from remote share requires share location and credentials
Agent setup files must be delivered if Server machine has no internet
In offline mode Veeam Installation Server accessed via API endpoint to download setup files
Server requires certificate validation (CRL access) when connecting to Veeam Installation Server

B.notes: Does not list the setup wizard inputs; internet access is a Veeam Intelligence limitation, and dedicated machines are a recommendation, not a requirement.

claims.text: Recon included in Advanced and Premium editions of VDP Universal License
Not supported for VDP Essentials

Earlier v2.1 supported up to 5 servers
Up to 15 additional users in the Coveware account
